address: 18501 Van Zandt Resort Rd, Philo, CA 95466
geo_notes: Coordinates from the Google Maps place link on the-land.us/visiting (goo.gl/maps/tq1rkngX2sGtXtkb9 -> 'The Land' @39.0519487,-123.4485054), about 1.5 km south of Philo village at the end of Van Zandt Resort Road on the Navarro River. OSM has Van Zandt Resort Road at 39.0599,-123.4447 (consistent). The site's JSON-LD lists geo 39.0429,-123.4283, which is ~2.4 km off and appears to be a rough approximation; the Google pin was preferred. Nominatim was rate-limiting (429) during research so the address itself was not house-number geocoded.

notes: Site (the-land.us) is a custom React/Lovable build; images are served from /__l5e/assets-v1/ paths. The site now brands the property as a 162-acre retreat center in Anderson Valley and also as 'The Eros Monastery' (practice-infused stays), with a 'True North' retreat and a Women's Retreat program; it hosts corporate retreats and weddings. Directions page says check-in 2-6pm, all guests 18+, alcohol/cannabis-free property, saltwater pool and Navarro River access, AT&T/T-Mobile work but Verizon does not. Phone (707) 485-3117 and info@the-land.us confirmed on site.
